data_fields.name: advanceRadiusInnerMinMidMax
data_fields.donor_constant: graph vars CPR_InnerRadiusMin/Mid/Max; delta<=0 maps min..mid, delta>0 maps mid..max, unclamped

data_fields.name: advanceRadiusOuterMinMidMax
data_fields.donor_constant: graph vars CPR_OuterRadiusMin/Mid/Max; same rescale rule

best_idea: Gate a spacing band (centre distance minus target radius, widened by weapon ranges) first, then make one seeded roll against a chance that never drops below a small floor outside the band; rescale the retreat distance and wait by one per-style multiplier, floored at the actor's diameter.
decision_why: The band-plus-one-roll gate and the style-scaled retreat are the right shape for 1-vs-1 spacing and the fallback step; take the shape, make every number catalogue or zone data, seed the roll on the server, and do not take the Skyrim hook layer or the per-frame roll.
acceptance: Server test: with optimalRange 2.0, maxRange 3.0, circleMin 1.0, circleMax 1.0 (band 3.0 to 4.0), a gap of 3.5 with engine chance 0.5 circles on roll 0.2 and not on roll 0.9; a gap of 5.0 never circles and its chance is max(0.1, minChance).
